title: Level up with a cap
prompt: Members `max_health` at 100. Write `level_up`, which doubles max_health but never lets it pass 500. In `max_health_capped`, call level_up four times. Then return max_health, which is 500.

docs.name: a * b
docs.what: Multiplies two numbers. * with a float keeps decimals.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.

solution:
var max_health = 100

func max_health_capped():
	level_up()
	level_up()
	level_up()
	level_up()
	return max_health

func level_up():
	max_health *= 2
	if max_health > 500:
		max_health = 500
